notes: TQ2020-BXXC-SO denotes the bi-directional pair solution; orderable variants are TQ2020-BADC-SO (Tx/Rx 1271/1331 nm) and TQ2020-BDAC-SO (Tx/Rx 1331/1271 nm). Single-fiber BiDi: two modules inject different wavelengths on one SM fiber. Module includes KP4 FEC; host system shall not have FEC activated. Optical parameters specified at BER 2.4x10^-4; FEC yields BER better than 1x10^-12. Aggregated line rate 106.25 Gbps for 100GbE with FEC (footnote 3). Line baud rate 52.125 Gbd (footnote 4); text also states 50 Gbaud per channel/lane. Transmitter output power and minimum receive power footnotes 5–6: average power per lane; min average receive power is informative. Footnote 7: typical values vary between components. Footnote 8: receiver sensitivity/specified at BER 2.4x10^-4. OMA transmitter min +0.7 dBm, max +4.7 dBm; receiver sensitivity OMA -6.1 dBm. Power budget 0–6.8 dB. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C (not operating). DDM via I2C per QSFP28 MSA.
suggestions: Consider schema fields for optical modulation amplitude (OMA) on TX and RX separately from average power. Power budget 0–6.8 dB may map to a dedicated link-budget field.
